craft_notes: Sthāyin: canon seal. Sanskrit-first: kṛpayā grace-word kept. Rows: 2. Close: every tongue. Rejected: closing on books alone — killed: grace is the cause. Read aloud: handing-down cadence.

lines: Short rule, grace-told, by Śiva sung —
